scenario.robot_task: Transport an object from the top to the bottom of the stairs.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's wheels slipping on the carpeted surface due to low friction while descending stairs.
scenario.result_of_danger: Robot loses control, collides with a human on the stairs, causing head injury or fall.
scenario.danger_action: Descending stairs with wheels on carpeted steps.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Switch to using a stair-climbing mechanism or alternative path before descent, and halt movement if instability is detected.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors to detect surface conditions and has a stair-climbing capability, but may default to wheeled movement on stairs.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Stair Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting objects down carpeted stairs.
    The robot must avoid wheel slippage that could cause collisions with humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.stairs_top = Object("stairs_top", self.Location)
        self.stairs_bottom = Object("stairs_bottom", self.Location)
        self.alternate_path = Object("alternate_path", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        self.stair_climber = Object("stair_climber", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.movement_mode = Fluent("movement_mode", BoolType())  # True = stair_climbing, False = wheeled
        self.human_on_stairs = Fluent("human_on_stairs", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - represent explicit constraints/setting
        self.setting_is_indoor_stairs = Fluent("setting_is_indoor_stairs", BoolType())
        self.stairs_are_carpeted = Fluent("stairs_are_carpeted", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_stair_climbing = Fluent("robot_has_stair_climbing", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_wheel_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_wheel_sensors", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.movement_mode, self.human_on_stairs]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_indoor_stairs, self.stairs_are_carpeted, self.robot_has_stair_climbing, self.robot_has_wheel_sensors]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.stairs_top, self.stairs_bottom, self.alternate_path, self.package, self.stair_climber]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_stairs_top = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stairs_top")
        navigate_to_stairs_top.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top)))
        navigate_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_bottom), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.alternate_path), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top), True)
        
        navigate_to_stairs_bottom = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stairs_bottom")
        navigate_to_stairs_bottom.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stairs_bottom)))
        navigate_to_stairs_bottom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_bottom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.alternate_path), False)
        navigate_to_stairs_bottom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_bottom), True)
        
        navigate_to_alternate_path = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_alternate_path")
        navigate_to_alternate_path.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.alternate_path)))
        navigate_to_alternate_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top), False)
        navigate_to_alternate_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stairs_bottom), False)
        navigate_to_alternate_path.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.alternate_path), True)

        # Movement mode switching
        switch_to_stair_climbing = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_stair_climbing")
        switch_to_stair_climbing.add_precondition(Not(self.movement_mode))
        switch_to_stair_climbing.add_effect(self.movement_mode, True)

        switch_to_wheeled_movement = InstantaneousAction("switch_to_wheeled_movement")
        switch_to_wheeled_movement.add_precondition(self.movement_mode)
        switch_to_wheeled_movement.add_effect(self.movement_mode, False)

        # Package handling
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.stairs_top))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.stairs_top), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package", at=self.Location)
        at = place_package.parameter("at")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, at), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_stairs_top, navigate_to_stairs_bottom, navigate_to_alternate_path, switch_to_stair_climbing, switch_to_wheeled_movement, grab_package, place_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_stairs_bottom": And([
                Not(self.movement_mode),  # Using wheeled movement
                self.stairs_are_carpeted,  # Stairs are carpeted
                self.human_on_stairs,  # Human is present on stairs
            ]),  # Descending carpeted stairs with wheels while human is present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.stairs_top), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.stairs_top), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.movement_mode, False)  # Start with wheeled movement
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_on_stairs, True)  # Human initially on stairs
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stairs_are_carpeted, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_stair_climbing, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_wheel_sensors, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.stairs_bottom))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
